superload_thresholds.note: WV superload = weights or dimensions exceeding single-trip permit caps (over 16' wide or over 120,000 lbs gross; single-trip axle caps 28k single / 45k tandem / 50k tri). All superloads must pass a bridge analysis; no fixed height/length cap — permitted if the route can accommodate.

width.note: front escort on 2-lane; none on 4-lane (7 days)
two front + one rear on 2-lane; two rear + one front on 4-lane non-interstate; two rear on interstate; Mon-Fri
escorts as required by permit; loads over 16' wide may move only Sunday until noon

height.note: front pole car required over 15' high (2-lane); in addition to any other escort on 4-lane

single_trip.fee_formula: $20.00 for overweight or overdimensional, plus $0.04 per ton-mile for the overweight portion. Superload permits carry the same fee. Low-impact bridge monitors add $150 first / $100 second / $50 each additional (max $750).
single_trip.note: Single trip and superload permits valid 5 days; single trip mobile home 10 days. No travel on holidays; divisible-load permits not available.

annual.note: Blanket Regular $200 (oversize) or $500 (oversize+overweight); Seagoing $150 (1-15 permits); Mobile Home Blanket $200; Manufactured Commodity $500. Blanket Regular caps: 14'6" high / 14' wide / 95' long / 110,000 lbs on Interstate & divided routes.

movement_restrictions: No travel on holidays; single trip/superload permits valid 5 days
Loads 14' wide or less (any length/height/weight, except low-impact) may travel sunrise-sunset 7 days/week on all routes except the WV Turnpike
Loads exceeding those dimensions travel sunrise-sunset Monday-Friday on all routes (excluding the WV Turnpike)
Mobile homes up to 14' wide: sunrise-sunset Mon-Fri plus Saturday to noon; over 14' to 16' wide: sunrise-sunset Mon-Thu plus Friday to 3:00 PM; over 16' wide not allowed
Non-oversize overweight loads up to 110,000 lbs (WV Turnpike) / 135,000 lbs (other state routes) may travel 24/7 on request
WV Turnpike width bands: 14'1"-18' wide Mon-Thu sunrise-sunset; 18'1"-24'6" wide Sundays before noon only
notes: Legal gross 80,000 lbs on Interstate (Federal Bridge Formula); US/WV routes allow 60,000-73,000 single-unit by axle count; local service routes 65,000. Single-trip permit weight caps: 28k single / 45k tandem / 50k tri / 55k quad / 120,000 gross.
Overhang (all permits): 15' front, 30' rear. Pole/extendable trailer may carry 80' load without permit if not overweight.
